<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>incident</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>AI Eligibility Check</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    // Condition 1: not active
    if (current.active == false) {
        gs.info("AI Orchestrator Suppression [" + current.number + "]: Incident is not active.");
        return;
    }

    // Condition 2: AI-enabled
    if (current.x_2215689_ai_inc_0_ai_enabled == false) {
        gs.info("AI Orchestrator Suppression [" + current.number + "]: AI is not enabled for this incident.");
        return;
    }

    // Condition 3: already processed
    if (current.x_2215689_ai_inc_0_u_ai_processing_state == 'complete') {
        gs.info("AI Orchestrator Suppression [" + current.number + "]: Incident is already processed.");
        return;
    }

    // Condition 4: supported category
    var supportedCategories = ['software', 'hardware', 'network', 'database', 'password_reset'];
    if (supportedCategories.indexOf(current.getValue('category')) == -1) {
        gs.info("AI Orchestrator Suppression [" + current.number + "]: Incident category is not supported.");
        return;
    }

    // Condition 5: already running
    var state = current.x_2215689_ai_inc_0_u_ai_processing_state;
    if (state == 'in_progress' || state == 'waiting_for_retry' || state == 'awaiting_approval') {
        gs.info("AI Orchestrator Suppression [" + current.number + "]: Incident is being processed.");
        return;
    }

    // Condition 6: human-locked
    if (current.x_2215689_ai_inc_0_human_lock == true) {
        gs.info("AI Orchestrator Suppression [" + current.number + "]: Incident is being processed by a human.");
        return;
    }

    // If we reach this point, the incident is eligible.
    try {

        var event_type = '';

        if (current.isNewRecord()){
            event_type = "Insert";
        }
        else{
            event_type = "Update";
        }
        var payload = {
            "event_id": gs.generateGUID(),
            "incident_sys_id": current.getValue('sys_id'),
            "number": current.getValue('number'),
            "event_type": event_type
        };

        var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        // Replace YOUR_ENDPOINT with your public ngrok URL, keep /webhook:
        r.setEndpoint('https://webhook.site/818273b6-89e1-4206-8a48-64eb86cd9b42');
        r.setHttpMethod('POST');
        r.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');

		// TODO: Uncomment and add Mostafa's OAuth profile once S1.2 is done
        // r.setAuthenticationProfile('oauth2', 'INSERT_MOSTAFA_PROFILE_SYS_ID');
		
        r.setRequestBody(JSON.stringify(payload));
        r.executeAsync();

        gs.info('Sent incident ' + current.getValue('number'));
    } catch (ex) {
        gs.error('Failed to send incident: ' + ex.message);
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-09 21:39:19</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>ed7e89a4c3578f10b9523342b4013144</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AI Eligibility Check</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="AI Incident Orchestrator" source="x_2215689_ai_inc_0">4493a537c3c30b10b9523342b4013167</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AI Incident Orchestrator">4493a537c3c30b10b9523342b4013167</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_ed7e89a4c3578f10b9523342b4013144</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-10 00:18:59</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=ed7e89a4c3578f10b9523342b4013144"/></record_update>
